coupling: The first edit lets a destination vector with sufficient capacity bypass the input bounds check in Decoder::readUTF8Bytes. Existing callers pass empty vectors, so their capacity is zero and readBytes still enforces the decoder bounds. The second edit pre-reserves the declared name length and routes extended Wasm name validation through readUTF8Bytes. With only the second edit, readUTF8Bytes still calls readBytes and rejects a length beyond the module buffer. Together, the reserved destination capacity satisfies the new fast path, so a malformed declared name length advances the decoder without validating the source bounds and IsUtf8 reads beyond the WebAssembly.Module byte buffer.
